The whole world has now heard about Kenyan Gen Z.

Some people love them
Some people hate them
But either way....
Its undeniable that

Lift them high,

Twitter into thunder,

I gave them a seat at the table... and shares in the kitchen.
I have never looked back.

Let them fly the plane.

Because the only system powerful and transparent enough to hold Gen Z’s fire is blockchain 🔗🔥
